seo.title: Business Automation & Custom Software | SynergyFirst Digital
seo.metaDescription: Business automation and custom software for local businesses: CRM, WhatsApp and booking integrations, AI-assisted workflows and internal tools.
seo.ogDescription: Useful systems, integrations and AI-assisted workflows that reduce repetitive work.

sections.subheading: Useful systems, integrations and AI-assisted workflows that reduce repetitive work and help your team operate more efficiently.

sections.heading: Let software handle the repetitive work
body: Many small businesses lose time and leads to manual tasks: replying to the same questions, copying details between tools, or chasing enquiries. Automation removes that friction so every lead is captured and followed up, and your team can focus on the work only people can do.
We build practical systems that connect to your website, from booking and CRM to messaging and AI assistants, and we can develop custom tools when an off-the-shelf product does not fit.

sections.heading: What our automation and custom solutions include
sections.intro: The scope grows with your plan, and we tailor the real thing to your business.

items.title: Booking and CRM systems
items.body: The Business plan includes booking and CRM systems, so enquiries are tracked and nothing slips through the cracks.

items.title: WhatsApp integration
items.body: An optional upgrade that lets customers reach you on the messaging app they already use every day.

items.title: AI chatbot or automation
items.body: The E-Commerce plan includes an AI chatbot or automation, so common enquiries get an instant reply.

items.title: Custom software development
items.body: Internal tools, dashboards and CRMs built around how your business actually works, included in the E-Commerce plan.

items.title: AI-assisted website edits
items.body: On-demand AI-assisted edits speed up changes to your site on the E-Commerce plan.

items.title: Multi-location management
items.body: The E-Commerce plan manages several locations across websites and listings.

sections.heading: Start with the problem, not the tool
body: We recommend automation only where it solves a real problem, never because it is fashionable. Tell us where your team loses time, and we will suggest the simplest system that fixes it.
Have a specific tool or workflow in mind? Book a call and we will discuss what it would take to build it for your business.
